title: California Government Code section 8214 - Liability of notary and sureties for misconduct or neglect
claims: Section 8214 provides that for the official misconduct or neglect of a notary public, the notary public and the sureties on the notary public's official bond are liable in a civil action to the persons injured thereby for all the damages sustained.
notes: Fetched 2026-09-30 from the publisher's own site and read in full. The section states that the notary and the sureties are liable for all the damages sustained; it does not itself state how that interacts with the fifteen thousand dollar bond amount in section 8212, and this record does not resolve that.
